title: Owner Auto Policy Rating Bulletin — Ride-Hailing and Delivery Use by a Reported Resident Listed Before Exclusion
content:
**Platform-use relativity.** Under the company's filed driver rating, a platform-use relativity multiplies the listing share of a household resident listed on the Owner Auto Policy before exclusion. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent. The relativity counts the claim reports of the term, on the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) claim file, that name the resident as operator with the vehicle in use on a ride-hailing or delivery platform at the time of loss.

| Such claim reports | Relativity |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.3 |
| one | 1.15 |
| none | 1 |

**Hypothetical readings.**
- A resident named on three claim reports, one of them recording platform use, takes 1.15.
- Two reports recording platform use take 1.3.
